audit.whatIsWrong: MAJOR: the content layer credits Galio with 'Righteous Gust' in two places (the late paragraph and wants.foe[1]). Galio has no such ability — it was removed in his rework years ago. Separately, early and spikes[0] refer to 'his passive shield'. Galio's passive is Colossal Smash, an empowered area basic attack, with no shield attached.
audit.why: Kit file: P Colossal Smash (empowered auto), Q Winds of War (825, 11-7s), W Shield of Durand (275, 18-14s, taunt and damage), E Justice Punch (650, 11-7s, dash and knockup), R Hero's Entrance. The real lane rule the page never gave: everything Galio has that touches you starts with Justice Punch at 650, and Shield of Durand cannot reach you at all unless he has already connected. Hold Heroic Swing for that knockup rather than spending it on poke, and note he can cut your retreat with it — from missingInteractions, that is what Flash is for here, not the damage.
audit.corrected: Righteous Gust removed and replaced with Shield of Durand. Passive named correctly as Colossal Smash and explicitly flagged as not a shield. The 650/275 range gap stated as the spacing rule.
